author: Zegita
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zRlXfJDrFws

0:13 put the speed on normal and then put it on 0.25. What he does is that his aim locks onto a different player whilst fighting someone else really quickly and that is presumably a glitch in his ghost client. It's a form of click aimbot perhaps. Now I don't know how to report this properly but I want a sr mod (preferably Posighdun or Javi ) to come speak to me about this. This is solid proof and you cannot deny the fact that this is not "hacking" of course it is. This had not been of a lag spike or moving his mouse due to a high sens no - it's a client. Lag spiking occurs when they have a shit ton of programmes running or their internet is playing up or their Minecraft is getting low FPS. Judging by the video Seuthy is getting nowhere near bad FPS. Having a high sens would not mean he would DIRECTLY lock onto another player "their body". You could tell if they had a high sens and the fact that he automatically turns back to another body? Yeah that is definitely not legit.  Furthermore, I'd like to adress that he is banned on kohi as well for hacking (https://kohi.net/u/Seuthy/) bear in mind that this ban was recent about 3 months ago? From my sources, I will know if Seuthy is told about this report so staff do not dare to tell Seuthy about this because I will know if you did and that will result in you leaking and potentially getting banned for leaking.

May I also tell you that the video is sped up by Seuthy because he is trying to cover the fact that he is hacking. The fact that even in his Avicus post (https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/08e366516) he stated that he had to render the video in "3 different formats" and it wasn't "fun". Yeah because it is hard for someone like him to blatantly hack and having to try cover it up in front of your audience so of course he would of found it difficult. I am requesting that Seuthy gets screenshared FULLY by PROPER screensharers that know what they are doing. I also request that I would want to watch it as well because I am pretty confident in screensharing. I am 90% sure Seuthy hacks and has a ghost client and the thing he used in that video was toggling Click Aimbot. If you don't know what that is search it up. I also would like if that if a staff member who is in Apollo and is a sr mod that is either Zeusy or Edans or Fouled to not reply to this as they are in Apollo and I'm sorry but you may tell Seuthy privately about this so I can not trust you three. Therefore, I would like it if Posighdun, Javi or Grape replied to this and tell me about the situation and to talk to me about it. I talked to Greg about this issue but no offense to Greg he does not know much about the "hacking" department in Minecraft therefore I would prefer Posighdun or Javi. I don't know what more evidence I can give to you but I am sure he is hacking definitely in that video and therefore he deserves to be checked or something dealt with him. Thank you for reading.

EDIT: Forgot to say this as well but notice how he is always hitting his teammates when they are close. That is a form of triggerbot as well just to point out. Whenever he has a sword he is always hitting whenever his teammates or enemies are close so it's either an autoclicker or a triggerbot
